# Keep work done with interrupts masked short

Long work between the firmware lock and unlock runs with interrupts off.

**Category:** hazard · <span class="pill pill-beta">Corroborated</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om3 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om3-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-3](../cameras/om3.md)

Pack and checksum into a buffer before the lock and only copy inside it. That a missed interrupt froze the camera is the project's inference.

> **What happens:** A rare, timing-dependent freeze; one test build failed once on the camera.

**Symptoms:** [Freezes until the battery is pulled](index.md#freeze)

## Observations

- **Emulator** ([Caduceus for OM-3](../projects/caduceus-om3.md)): OM-Emu counted 212,851 instructions masked per save; packing first cut it to 10,062. Source: [OM-3 research notebook](../sources/om3.notes.md).
- **Emulator** ([OM-Emu](../projects/om-emu.md)): Recorded the count and that the camera test passed after the change; proposes per-step masked counts. Source: [OM-Emu study of Caduceus OM-3](../sources/emu.caduceus-om3.md).

**[Full detail upstream](https://github.com/androidfanman/caduceus-om3/blob/e32363a01aef5f0119e750f35bc96644e6d9b4eb/research/NOTES.md#per-film-r--g--b-tone-curves-build-2026-11-15-featurergb-curves-emulator-only)**
